HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

6. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

8. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   B. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. A — Nairobi
